name: Angirasa
reason: Descendant or follower of the Vedic sage Angiras; meaning acceptable.

name: Ashtavakra
reason: negative_meaning: Means "eight-bent", a reference to bodily deformity; families rarely choose it.

name: Charudeshna
reason: obscure_figure: Minor son of Krishna; not used as a given name.

name: Gritsamada
reason: obscure_figure: Little-known Rigvedic seer; hard to pronounce and not a common given name.

name: Kratu
reason: Meaning made more precise.

fix.meaning_en: Resolve, power, sacrificial intent; one of the seven sages.

name: Madhuchchhanda
reason: obscure_figure: Minor Rigvedic seer; also Devanagari has a stray long ā not matching iast.

name: Medhatithi
reason: Meaning made cautious; traditional analysis uncertain.

fix.meaning_en: Rigvedic seer of the Kanva family; name often read as "one whose guest is wisdom" (etymology uncertain).

name: Pippalada
reason: Pippala is the pipal (sacred fig) tree, not fig seeds.

fix.meaning_en: Name of the sage of the Prashna Upanishad; traditionally "eater of pipal fruit".

name: Pulastya
reason: Meaning was only a description; etymology uncertain.

fix.meaning_en: One of the seven great sages, father of Vishrava; etymology uncertain.

name: Samba
reason: Meaning expanded; also a name of Shiva.

fix.meaning_en: "With Amba (Parvati)"; a name of Shiva, also a son of Krishna.

name: Shukracharya
reason: title_or_honorific: Teacher of the asuras with the title acharya; not a given name.

name: Shunahshepa
reason: negative_meaning: Means "dog's tail"; also an obscure figure.

name: Sridama
reason: Devanagari had stray long ā not matching iast; meaning refined.

fix.meaning_en: Garland of Shri (fortune); a cowherd friend of Krishna in the Bhagavata Purana.

name: Subala
reason: Strong; a cowherd friend of Krishna; meaning correct.

name: Uddalaka
reason: Meaning was only a description; etymology uncertain.

fix.meaning_en: Uddalaka Aruni, the Upanishadic sage and teacher of Shvetaketu; etymology uncertain.

name: Upananda
reason: obscure_figure: Obscure figure; the meaning "elder brother of Nanda" is not a meaning of the name.

name: Ushanas
reason: epithet_not_given_name: Vedic epithet of Shukra, the asura teacher; not used as a given name.

name: Vamadeva
reason: Meaning refined; vāma means lovely or auspicious.

fix.meaning_en: Beautiful or auspicious god; a name of Shiva and a Rigvedic seer.

name: Varahamihira
reason: author_or_scholar: Full name of a historical astronomer-author; not used as a given name.

name: Yajnavalkya
reason: Meaning was only a description; etymology uncertain.

fix.meaning_en: The great sage of the Brihadaranyaka Upanishad; etymology uncertain.
